tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a full-body visual-novel sprite of Dori for desire, using only the supplied approved neutral as the image reference. Preserve the character’s identity, face, skin tone, hair, costume, accessories, style, and compact small-female proportions. A longing for a treasured treat: softer open eyes, flushed cheeks, looking slightly aside. Angle her body subtly, one hand near her heart and the other held against her. Keep all acting wholesome and child-appropriate. Each hand has one anatomically placed thumb and four fingers joined to a single palm and wrist. Use clear, simple hand silhouettes, no foreshortening, and do not force hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and two feet, in an uncomplicated stance. Complete silhouette with headwear, hair, hands, accessories and shoes visible, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects or baked ground shadow.
